Agenda
Item 1
Relocation Policy Update for Remote Workforce

The Relocation Policy Update for Remote Workforce was a review of the company's compliance with the Lobbying Disclosure Act. The committee reviewed the company's lobbying activities and confirmed that they were in compliance.

Item 2
Dividend Policy Review

{chair} presented the {item_title} for committee review. The analysis, prepared by ACPWB engagement team, covered {n} employee records across {regions} organizational units. Discussion focused on variance from prior-year benchmarks and alignment with the {industry} peer group. Members raised questions regarding methodology and timeline for implementation. {chair} noted that all supporting documentation is available as Exhibit {exhibit} in the meeting materials.

Motion

To approve for vision: RESOLVED, that the Sustainability and Corporate Responsibility Committee approves the annual budget for the Dividend Policy Review in the amount of $36M for fiscal year 2017.

Moved: William Mekonnen  •  Seconded: Tariq Sanford
Vote: 4 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  1 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 3
Healthcare Cost Containment Initiative Update

The committee reviewed the quarterly performance metrics related to the Healthcare Cost Containment Initiative Update. Tariq Sanford reported that all KPIs were within the target range, with the exception of a 5% shortfall in the 17 region. A plan to address this regional variance was requested for the next meeting.

Motion

To appoint: RESOLVED, that the Sustainability and Corporate Responsibility Committee determines that the compensation for the Named Executive Officers for fiscal year 2017 is reasonable and in the best interests of the company and its shareholders.

Moved: Tariq Sanford  •  Seconded: William Mekonnen
Vote: 5 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
